title: Apply rotary embeddings
goal:
Implement the rotation from Section 3.4.2, Equation 34. Write `rope(x, positions, base=10000.0)`, where `x` has shape `(..., n, d)` with `d` even, and `positions` has shape `(n,)`.

The function returns an array of the same shape. Follow the paper's pairing: coordinates `(x[2j], x[2j+1])` form pair `j` (0-indexed), and pair `j` rotates by the angle $m\,\theta_j$ with $\theta_j = \text{base}^{-2j/d}$ (Equation 15, with the paper's 1-indexed $i = j + 1$). Position `positions[t]` applies to row `t`. Every leading axis, such as batch and head, uses the same positions.
hints: Build the angles with broadcasting: `positions[:, None] * theta[None, :]` has shape `(n, d // 2)`.
Take the even coordinates with `x[..., 0::2]` and the odd ones with `x[..., 1::2]`. The rotated pair is `(a cos - b sin, a sin + b cos)`.
Write the two results back into `out[..., 0::2]` and `out[..., 1::2]`. Don't split `x` into a first half and a second half; that is a different pairing.
